schemes.scheme_name_verbatim: Transparent Reporting of Ethics for Generative Artificial Intelligence (TREGAI) checklist

dimensions.definition_quote: The explicit clarifications of to whom and to what extent responsibility and/or legal liability fall.
dimensions.quote: The explicit clarifications of to whom and to what extent responsibility and/or legal liability fall.

dimensions.definition_quote: The preservation and fostering of patients' dignity, rights for self- determination and capacity to make informed decisions.
dimensions.quote: The preservation and fostering of patients' dignity, rights for self- determination and capacity to make informed decisions.

dimensions.definition_quote: The use of generative AI to promote equity according to some notion of fairness (e.g., equality of opportunity, outcomes, etc.) in health
dimensions.quote: The use of generative AI to promote equity according to some notion of fairness (e.g., equality of opportunity, outcomes, etc.) in health

dimensions.dimension_label_verbatim: Integrity (in medical education and quality of clinical research)
dimensions.definition_quote: The commitment to intellectual honesty, and personal responsibility to abide by responsible research conduct, including data integrity, to establish accountability and prevent harm.
dimensions.quote: The commitment to intellectual honesty, and personal responsibility to abide by responsible research conduct, including data integrity, to establish accountability and prevent harm.

dimensions.definition_quote: The prevention of harm and potential risks to patients associated with generative AI use in healthcare.
dimensions.quote: The prevention of harm and potential risks to patients associated with generative AI use in healthcare.

dimensions.definition_quote: The protection of patients' information from illegitimate access, and of confidentiality of personal sensitive information.
dimensions.quote: The protection of patients' information from illegitimate access, and of confidentiality of personal sensitive information.

dimensions.definition_quote: The protection of health data integrity and safety, through careful assessments of vulnerabilities in data systems and the prevention of data breaches, cyberattacks or other
dimensions.quote: The protection of health data integrity and safety, through careful assessments of vulnerabilities in data systems and the prevention of data breaches, cyberattacks or other

dimensions.definition_quote: The full-disclosure and thorough documentation of information regarding generative AI development, including its data set and evaluation of performance.
dimensions.quote: The full-disclosure and thorough documentation of information regarding generative AI development, including its data set and evaluation of performance.

dimensions.definition_quote: The confidence of users in generative AI and/or its developers, and expectations that the model is competent in performing its pre-specified tasks and behave in
dimensions.quote: The confidence of users in generative AI and/or its developers, and expectations that the model is competent in performing its pre-specified tasks and behave in
the additional important principle of Beneficence

dimensions.definition_quote: the level of AI involvement is classified based on the highest level of usage
dimensions.quote: At this initial level of involvement, the human author is exclusively responsible for the written content.

dimensions.dimension_label_verbatim: Specify the level of AI assistance
dimensions.definition_quote: Clearly state the extent of AI involvement, ranging from proofreading to, perhaps eventually, full manuscript generation.
dimensions.quote: Clearly state the extent of AI involvement, ranging from proofreading to, perhaps eventually, full manuscript generation.

dimensions.definition_quote: Specify the degree of human involvement and oversight throughout the manuscript development process, including editing, revising, and validating AI-generated content.
dimensions.quote: Specify the degree of human involvement and oversight throughout the manuscript development process, including editing, revising, and validating AI-generated content.

dimensions.dimension_label_verbatim: Describe the AI tool or model
dimensions.definition_quote: Provide a brief description of the AI tool or model utilized, including the software name and version number where appropriate, the LLM or
dimensions.quote: Provide a brief description of the AI tool or model utilized, including the software name and version number where appropriate, the LLM or

dimensions.definition_quote: Disclose any ethical considerations related to the use of AI in manuscript development, such as potential biases relevant to the subject matter.
dimensions.quote: Disclose any ethical considerations related to the use of AI in manuscript development, such as potential biases relevant to the subject matter.

dimensions.definition_quote: Recognize the limitations of AI use, including potential biases, inaccuracies, or misinterpretations that may arise from AI-generated content.
dimensions.quote: Recognize the limitations of AI use, including potential biases, inaccuracies, or misinterpretations that may arise from AI-generated content.

dimensions.definition_quote: Reveal any potential conflicts of interest, particularly when using commercial AI tools, to maintain transparency and avoid potential biases.
dimensions.quote: Reveal any potential conflicts of interest, particularly when using commercial AI tools, to maintain transparency and avoid potential biases.

dimensions.quote: Is policy on AI included in the guidelines?

dimensions.definition_quote: Is authorship for AI tools allowed or prohibited?
dimensions.quote: Is authorship for AI tools allowed or prohibited?
